facts: §2.1 / drawing p.6: 50 pin 0.5 mm pitch FPC for a ZIF connector, FPC+stiffener 0.30 +/-0.03, conductor W 0.35, 25.50 across the contacts

§3.1 front view (display side, drawn turned 90 deg, the FPC leaving the panel's short edge): contacts drawn on the viewer's side, numbered 1 at the end beside the LED test pads ... 50 at the other; the stiffener on the back (side view: STIFFENER and CONDUCTOR on opposite faces)
Turned so the FPC hangs below the glass edge, pin 1 is on the right, as on the ER-TFT035IPS-6 (same EastRising 50-pin family)
Folding the tail 180 deg behind the panel keeps x and flips the face: contacts face down onto the PCB = bottom contact, panel pin 1 at +x (right, seen from above)
Board: case/positions.json fpc_conn (99.61, 108.18), J3 rot 0, mouth +y (seat 1), fpc_zones 83.36..115.86 x 104.23..131.23
KiCad Hirose_FH12-50S-0.5SH footprint: pad 1 at x=-12.25 (left), pad 50 at +12.25, tails at -y, mouth +y
fpc_orientation.conclusion: J3 pin j = panel pin 51-j, unchanged from the 3.5in panel. To confirm on a real panel before ordering (validation plan #135).
